sectionSubtitle: Professional journey in data engineering, AI, and full-stack development

experiences.title: Senior Data Engineer
contents: Building enterprise data platform foundations with Pulumi (TypeScript), codifying infrastructure and governance controls across multiple environments.
Implementing privacy-by-design controls in Snowflake (tag-based PII masking with deterministic hashing) for regulated enterprise environments.
Delivering end-to-end data ingestion pipelines with CDC via Fivetran to ADLS (Iceberg) and Snowflake (external volumes, catalog integration).
Improving platform reliability through CI/CD hardening with reusable GitHub Actions workflows, environment gates, and connector-specific credentials.

experiences.title: Senior Data Engineer (Full-Stack & Data Products)
contents: Developed large-scale data ingestion platforms using Python, Azure Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, and SQL, processing 10M+ records/month.
Designed distributed ETL/ELT pipelines orchestrated with Airflow and Azure Data Factory, reducing manual integration effort by ~80%.
Built data validation, monitoring, and alerting frameworks including anomaly detection, schema drift, and SLA tracking.
Optimized SQL transformations and indexing strategies, reducing query execution from ~18s to under 3s.

experiences.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer
contents: Delivering production data and backend systems using Python and SQL, designing scalable APIs supporting 10K+ requests/day.
Building scalable data pipelines with Airflow and Databricks/PySpark (batch and streaming), reducing refresh cycles by up to 80%.
Architecting cloud-native data platforms across Azure, AWS, and GCP with Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, reducing infrastructure costs by ~35%.
Implementing monitoring, evaluation, and observability practices for data and AI-driven systems using LangSmith and Datadog.

experiences.title: Data Engineer
contents: Designed interactive Power BI dashboards and automated reporting pipelines with Python, reducing manual effort by ~70%.
Integrated data from SAP, APIs, SQL databases, and Azure Data Lake into a centralized analytical environment.
Built distributed processing pipelines with PySpark and SparkSQL, achieving 3-5x performance improvements over legacy processes.
Implemented Azure-based architectures using Synapse Analytics, ADLS, and Databricks for near real-time reporting.

experiences.title: Data Analyst Intern
contents: Consolidated data from Oracle, SQL/NoSQL systems, SAP, and shop-floor IoT sources for near real-time operational monitoring.
Developed automated Python scripts for data ingestion and cleansing, reducing manual spreadsheet work by ~60%.
Designed interactive Power BI dashboards for production efficiency, machine downtime, and critical operational indicators.
Implemented data validation and anomaly detection rules, increasing data accuracy to 95%+.

experiences.title: B.Sc. Chemical Engineering
contents: Education in industrial process analysis, mathematical modeling, and system optimization.
First personal projects with Python automations for data analysis and automated reporting.
Solid foundation in systematic thinking and complex problem solving.
